anika: Quick PM follow-up: we identified three repeating issues for streaming endpoints — per-token timeouts on long generations, truncated final chunks, and reconnects that don't resume cleanly under load. Need short owners + due dates.

pete: I'll own reconnect logic. Action: make resume idempotent, add full jitter backoff, expose a resume header. ETA: 2023-12-01.

aj: I'll own partial-output signals. Action: emit `stream.eos_received`, `stream.final_chunk_size_bytes`, and a `partial_chunk_rate` metric; create a dashboard + alert. ETA: 2023-11-29.

maria: I'll run canaries for mobile + web and the network-throttle matrix for US/EU/APAC; validate client `Retry-After` handling. ETA: 2023-12-02.

sam: I'll add route-level `token_timeout_ms` and a feature-flagged override for long-gen routes (default 30s -> 90s). ETA: 2023-11-28.

anika: Thanks. Concrete action items: pete (reconnect PR + fuzz tests) due 12/01, aj (metrics + alert) due 11/29, sam (timeout FF) due 11/28, maria (canary matrix) due 12/02. Ops will run 24h smoke after canary.

ops-bot: deploybot: runbook job created `streaming/rel-2333`  id run-10421

anika: I'll add these to the PM action tracker and schedule a weekly 15-min check for 6 weeks. If >2 regressions occur we'll escalate. Please ping me if ETAs change. :white_check_mark:
